clues.text: A town in the south of Spain lies in a rich, green valley. Small streams cross it, and the high hills of a tall range rise close by.
clues.narrowing: rules out everything outside the valleys of southern Spain

source.quote: Estepona (Spanish pronunciation: [esteˈpona]) is a town and municipality in the comarca of the Costa del Sol, southern Spain. It is located in the province of Málaga, part of the autonomous community of Andalusia. Its district covers an area of 137 square kilometers in a fertile valley crossed by small streams and a mountainous areas dominated by the Sierra Bermeja, which reaches an elevation of 1,449 m at the peak of Los Reales.

clues.text: The sea and the hills wrap round this town and make a small climate of its own. The sun shines here on more than three hundred days each year.

source.quote: Due to its natural environment, surrounded by the sea and the mountains, Estepona has a micro-climate with over 325 days of sunshine per year.
